findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed coffee-bar sanitizer bucket to contain less than 100 PPM of Quat sanitizer. Discussed with PIC. PIC refilled bucket with new sanitizer measuring 200 PPM. Ensure concentration is tested regularly to prevent contamination of food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(B) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (B) An iodine solution shall have a: (1) Minimum temperature of 20°C (68°F), (2) PH of 5.0 or less or a PH no higher than the level for which the manufacturer specifies the solution is effective, and (3) Concentration between 12.5 MG/L and 25 MG/L.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: REPEAT-Inspector observed the cabinets under the coffee bar to be in a state of disrepair. Discussed with PIC. The particle board has swollen, cracked, and allowed the coating to peel away in some parts of the cabinet. Ensure these cabinets are replaced to render them smooth and easily cleanable. Due to violation being a repeat, a letter will be sent to the facility and facility owner.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-202.12: Inspector observed handwashing sink in women’s bathroom to not be dispensing hot water. Inspector and PIC ran the water for several minutes and water never increased in temperature. Discussed the importance of having hot water for proper handwashing. Ensure that all handwashing sinks have a temperature that reaches at least 100F. The inspector will follow up on 11/15/2024 to ensure repairs have been made.

(A) HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water of a temperature at least 100F through mixing valve. Pf

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.11: Observed caulking on women’s bathroom hand sink to be insufficient. Discussed with PIC and educated about the importance of keeping surfaces smooth and easily cleanable. The caulking should be replaced or repaired by next routine inspection.

(D) SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, scratching, decomposition, and distortion. C

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11:  Inspector observed a build-up of coffee residue on the underside of coffee machine dispensers. Notified PIC and educated on the importance of keeping these areas clean. Ensure that all non-food contact surfaces of equipment are kept clean of food debris and dust. These areas must be cleaned by the next routine inspection. 

(C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Multiple holes in the walls in the back area of the facility were observed.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure holes are closed to prevent pest entry and to obtain a smooth, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent surface.

REPEAT - 2 spots by the mop sink.  The large hole exposing the water access, and one above the water access.
- 2 spots above the hand sink in the back, these holes look like they were made from soap dispensers being removed.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
REPEAT - There is one piece of equipment no longer in use located in the storage room, an ice machine.  Discussed with PIC, equipment no longer in use shall be removed from the premises to help prevent pest harborage.  Ensure equipment no longer in use is removed from the facility.

6-501.114: The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Observed cabinets underneath coffee bar in a state of disrepair. The particle board in the cabinets has accumulated moisture and swelled. The swelling has exposed board fibers, as well as cracked the veneer off of the board. This renders the particle board un-cleanable and not structurally sound. Recommend replacing the cabinets below the coffee bar by next routine inspection.

PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-303.11: Observed no working lights in the walk-in cooler. Notified PIC and educated on the importance of having a certain level of light intensity in food-holding areas. Ensure that there are lights in the walk-in cooler by next routine inspection.

The light intensity shall be at least a certain lux and present in certain areas.
